note: Tests the starting build of round 4 fails, why, where it comes from (an item of REVIEW-v0.5.md, or of the author's notes in feedback/round4-author.md) and the step that fixes it. Measured on v0.6 (build R4F3, round 3 landed) on 22 Nov 2026. A step removes its entries when its tests pass under --must; a finished round passes --strict.

data.rest.why: 4 of the 5 settlements have nobody who offers a bed

data.notes.why: 11 texts of world.json still carry notes to the developer ("your round 3 quest giver")

data.sprites.questitems.why: the 17 quest things have no picture

credits.srd.sentence.why: the Credits page names the SRD but not the sentence and the two addresses ATTRIBUTION.md requires

credits.unaffiliated.why: the Credits page does not say the game is not affiliated with Wizards of the Coast

ui.title.continue.why: the title has no Continue: a reload starts a new game

ui.items.list.why: A on Items drinks a Healing Draught; there is no list with a cursor, and only 5 things are shown

ui.items.drink.why: a Potion of Healing cannot be drunk from the menu

ui.items.equip.why: nothing can be worn from the menu: every armour, weapon and ring the story gives is dead without the test hook

ui.items.unequip.why: worn gear is not in the list and cannot be taken off

ui.items.worn.why: no page shows what the hero wears

ui.shop.confirm.why: A buys at once, so A through the merchant's greeting buys the first ware

ui.shop.sell.why: there is no way to sell with the keys

ui.rest.inn.why: the innkeeper promises a bed and nothing heals

ui.rest.bed.why: the house has no bed to rest in

ui.battle.potion.why: START in a battle drinks only the round-3 Healing Draught, never a Potion of Healing

ui.battle.turn.why: a drink in battle costs no turn

ui.flee.boss.why: a story boss can be walked away from

ui.battle.names.why: long boss names are cut mid-word ("Vharaxis, the Ci")

story.ending.card.why: the end card shows behind the last talk and vanishes when it closes

story.ending.credits.why: no credits roll after the ending

story.ending.title.why: the game does not return to the title after the ending

story.rewards.why: chapter 1 pays its XP twice (60 hard-coded, then the data's 300)

story.boss.intro.why: a boss's challenge is shown after he is defeated: defeat steps have no `intro`

story.pages.whole.why: pages are cut every 78 letters, leaving pages like "it."

story.pages.fit.why: 3 pages of the story wrap to 4 lines; the 4th line falls below the dialogue box, dark on dark, and cannot be read

balance.hero.fixed.why: every new game rolls a different hero

balance.hero.hp.why: HP is a full d8 a level; rules.json gives the Ranger a d10 and the average after level 1

balance.boss.1.why: 23 % at level 1, the level the story really gives (the review's 61 % assumed level 2)

balance.boss.2.why: under 1 %: Garrick Redcap cannot be beaten at level 2

balance.boss.3.why: about 2 %: Old Mother Brine cannot be beaten at level 3

balance.boss.4.why: about a third at level 4 without a shield (the review's 49 % had one)

balance.boss.5.why: 0 %: the ettin cannot be beaten at level 4

balance.boss.6.why: 0 %: Hoarfang cannot be beaten at level 5

balance.boss.7.why: about 100 %: the High Cantor is no contest

balance.boss.8.why: 0 %: the Cinder King cannot be beaten at level 6; winter against fire is not a mechanic

balance.rewards.curve.why: The Pale Lady pays 10,000 XP and 1,000 gp, 3.4 and 2.5 times the best chapter

ui.title.animated.why: the title is a still picture

ui.title.nostatus.why: the status bar is drawn on the title

ui.intro.why: a new game starts on the map with no introduction

ui.shop.scroll.why: at the top of a shop only 3 wares are drawn and nothing shows that the list goes on (every ware can be reached with ArrowDown; this is the nearest fault found to "can't scroll down to buy items")

ui.battle.nobox.why: round 3's dark stage: 33-74 % of the area around the foe is near-black

ui.map.foes.why: 19 of 20 quest foes are drawn on the map with a frame of the town sheet, not their picture of sprites.json

story.quest.added.why: quests begin without a "quest added" message

ui.items.sections.why: the Items page does not separate worn gear from the bag

ui.items.hint.why: no row says what A will do

ui.items.compare.why: gear does not show what it changes for the hero

ui.shop.compare.why: the shop shows a name and a price, not what the ware changes for the hero

ui.battle.controls.why: "START: menu" is shown in a battle where START opens no menu; dice boxes are labelled d8 whatever the die; bare "?" and "-"

ui.battle.narration.why: the log is roll arithmetic ("You roll 20+6=26 HIT"), not narration

ui.chests.loot.why: no chest in a house gives loot

ui.doors.houses.why: only the hero's own house can be entered

ui.status.maponly.why: the status bar is drawn in battles; the battle screen uses only the top three quarters

ui.defeat.home.why: round 3 wakes the hero in the nearest settlement, which is often another town
